newsitem.title: YEMEN: Freed German tourists fly into Sanaa en route home.
newsitem.headline: Freed German tourists fly into Sanaa en route home.

text.p: Seven German tourists freed by their Yemeni captors arrived in the capital Sanaa on Wednesday as they prepared to return home, a senior security source said.

"The seven arrived at Sanaa international airport from Mukalla city in Hadramaut (province) on a Yemenia airlines plane and were greeted by the German ambassador and taken to a hotel to rest," he told Reuters.
